description.ru: Развивайте практический английский уровня B1 для работы по теме «Рабочие технологии и техническая поддержка».
description.en: Develop practical B1 workplace English for workplace technology and technical support.

data.question: Which response communicates the workplace situation most effectively?

options.text: I reported the technical issue after restarting the device failed to restore access.
